entries.title: Temple Courtyard Procession
entries.description: A rectangular temple courtyard with a central altar and a ring of colored spheres (people) that slowly orbit the altar, occasionally stopping to attach glowing offerings (small cubes) that stack, while incense particles rise and fade above the altar.
